{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data and drop duplicates, keeping highest sample_seq
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute response rates by sex
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Compute response rate by arm
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(response_by_arm)

# Compute response rate by sex within each arm
response_by_sex_arm = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack()
print("\nResponse rate by sex within each arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Compute response rate by sex within each severity level
response_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['severity', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack()
print("\nResponse rate by sex within each severity level:")
print(response_by_sex_severity)"}
